title: Jazzy Greek Lentil Pilaf
description: A vibrant, dairy‑free one‑pot pilaf infused with grapefruit, capers, and a crunchy sesame topping, finished in a crispy parchment papillote.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat until shimmering.
Add diced onion and minced garlic, sauté for 3‑4 minutes until translucent.
Stir in lentils, rice, and dried oregano, cooking for 2 minutes to toast the grains.
Pour in vegetable broth and grapefruit juice, bring to a gentle boil, then reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes until lentils and rice are tender and liquid absorbed.
Remove pot from heat and stir in capers, lemon juice, chopped dill, and toasted sesame seeds.
Transfer the pilaf onto a sheet of parchment paper, fold the parchment into a tight papillote packet.
Place the packet in a preheated oven at 375°F and bake for 10 minutes to crisp the top and steam the flavors.
Carefully unwrap, fluff the pilaf with a fork, and serve hot.
